whatIs: Stitch is an AI design canvas from Google Labs, currently in beta, that turns a prompt, a hand-drawn sketch, or a screenshot into editable screens for mobile and web apps. It uses Gemini models, lets you build multi-screen flows, and exports to Figma with Auto Layout or as HTML and CSS, with Tailwind support.
It's a good fit when you want to go quickly from an idea to a first visual version of an app and then take it to Figma or to code.
uses: Generating the first screens of a mobile app from a description to validate the idea.
Turning a sketch or a screenshot of another interface into an editable design.
Exporting a generated screen to HTML and Tailwind as a starting point for the front end.
caveats: It's in beta, English only, for people 18 and older, and in countries where Gemini is available.
Free use has a daily credit limit that resets at midnight UTC.
The generated code is a starting point: review it and adapt it to your project before using it in production.
pricingNote: Free for now, with a daily credit limit.
idealFor: Prototyping app interfaces with AI and moving them to Figma or to code.
